headline: Copper Price Drops Below $12,000 per Tonne on Doubts Over AI Data Center Demand
summary: Copper sank below $12,000 per tonne for the first time since March as investors re-examined metal demand forecasts for global data center buildouts.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal essential for electrical infrastructure, data centers, and global manufacturing.

impacts.name: Copper Futures
impacts.why: Copper benchmark prices broke key support levels to fall under $12,000 per tonne.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding artificial intelligence hardware demand and infrastructure spending reduced industrial metal buy orders.
